location.welcomeText: Tennisclub Waidberg is delighted to welcome you to the Waidcup at our grounds on the Käferberg. Here you'll find everything you need to know about the club and how to get there.
location.facilityText: Our clay courts sit amid greenery above the city. The clubhouse and terrace invite you to linger – come by and enjoy the tournament.
location.transitText: The nearest stop is “Waidbadstrasse”. From there it is about a 500 m walk to the grounds. As we expect many visitors, especially at weekends, we recommend travelling by public transport.
location.parkingText: There are only a few parking spaces in front of the grounds. If you do come by car, please download the TCW parking card, print it and place it clearly visible behind your windscreen. On site, please follow the instructions of the traffic marshals.
webcam.title: Live webcam of the grounds
infos.subtitle: Information for all participants
infos.hint1: The third set is played as a champions tie-break. In the finals, the third set is played out in full!
infos.hint5: Please travel by public transport or park in the public car parks below the grounds (limited spaces).
infos.hint6: In case of rain, indoor courts at the Grindel sports centre are available on the finals weekend. Matches in the earlier rounds may also be moved indoors due to weather.
infos.hint8: As a general rule, “playing without an umpire” applies:

helpers.subtitle: Shift schedule for Waidcup 2026 – search your name to find your slots.
helpers.noResults: No shifts found for this name.
helpers.dayEmpty: No shifts scheduled on this day.
helpers.task.spielleitung: Entry fees, give-away bags, parking card, balls, court assignment, result entry, order of play for the next day.
helpers.task.assistenz: Support the match desk during rushes and tricky matches, help reorganise matches when it rains, handle the first-aid kit for injuries.
helpers.task.barPommes: Sell all products on the price list, serve drinks, ice cream and bars, prepare fries, hand out and collect all coupons, sell raffle tickets, keep the sales tally.
helpers.task.pasta: Prepare pasta and salad plates, collect the pasta/salad coupons and return them to the bar.
helpers.task.grill: Fire up, grill, collect the grill coupons and return them to the bar, help out at the bar when it's busy!
helpers.task.springer: Jumps in wherever it's busiest – flexible between bar, grill and the match desk.
helpers.general: Please wait for your relief and tidy up in between so your successor can start clean. For the last shift of the day, cleaning up is part of the job. Please also check out briefly at the end of your shift. Thank you!
infos.hintPayment: At check-in you can pay by Twint or in cash.
